title: Press Only
description: Task: Enter the chess tournament as a member of the press. Solution: There are two Press Badges that allow Bond to bypass the security check at the press entrance. One is [inside a white case](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598383) in the security tent. The other is [hidden in a planter](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598366) on a lower level of the garden exterior.

title: Self Check-In
description: Task: Enter the chess tournament using an alternative entrance. Solution: Acquire a Lighter and ignite the [Dry Leaves](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598375). This distracts a nearby civilian so Bond can vault over the stone wall without witnesses. Scale across the stone ledge, climb up the pipe, then continue scaling ledges until you reach an open 3rd floor window. Alternatively, Bond can Bluff or sneak into the Staff-Only Area to the right of the security check and climb up the pipe there.

title: Lone Wolf
description: Task: Don't get spotted by any of the other recruits Solution: Bond's fellow recruits are scattered around the hotel. If you fail to avoid their detection, they'll comment on Bond's unauthorized wandering. - [Ronson](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598447) - 1st Floor, Reception Area - [Greenway](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598434) - 2nd Floor, audience member at the Chess Tournament - [Cressida](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598417) - 2nd Floor Corridor, overlooking the Reception - [Nash](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598419) - 2nd Floor Corridor, outside the Bar Room - [Kingsley](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598403) - 3rd Floor Lounge

title: Peace Studies
description: Task: Get through the study room without harming any guards. Solution: The opposite challenge to [Indiscrete](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598658). After traversing the Laundry Room, Bond will exit into Library through an open window. The objective will change to "Return to the Chess Tournament." Reach any Library exit without harming any guards to complete the challenge. Use environmental distractions to pull guards to slip past them.

title: Bellboy Hat
description: Task: Find the Bellboy hat. Solution: After crossing through the study, you'll end up in a hallway crowded with storage. Vault over a chest towards a hotel luggage cart. The Bellboy Hat is on top of a suitcase. Alternatively, you can access the same hallway on the way to the Laundry Room. Instead of heading down the stone stairs to laundry, walk past them towards a wooden door; open it to find the hotel luggage cart.

title: Getting Dirty
description: Task: Defeat 5 laundry workers in the laundry area. Solution: The opposite challenge to [Squeaky Clean](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598662). Use the environment to knockout laundry workers, or use good ol' fashion punching. Silent takedowns do NOT count.

title: Laundry Day
description: Task: Disguise yourself as a laundry worker. Solution: Find and use the [Laundry Worker](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598581) Disguise.

title: Silent Study
description: Task: Get through the study room without getting spotted. Solution: After traversing the Laundry Room, Bond will exit into Library through an open window. The objective will change to "Return to the Chess Tournament." Reach any Library exit without alerting anyone to Bond's presence. This pairs well with another Library challenge, [Peace Studies](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598449).

title: The Manager
description: Task: Enter the hotel manager's office. Solution: The Manager's Office can be reached through two restricted rooms. One has a single guard leaning against a billiards table; the other has two maids cleaning. Both routes can by bypassed with stealth, distractions, or bluffing.

title: Indiscrete
description: Task: Defeat 5 of the private security in the library. Solution: The opposite challenge to [Peace Studies](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598449). After traversing the Laundry Room, Bond will exit into Library through an open window. The objective will change to "Return to the Chess Tournament." Abandon stealth and start punching guards. Stealth takedowns do NOT count.

title: Old School Hacking
description: Task: Discover the code to access the laundry area. Solution: Inspect the note on the Manager's Office desk to discover the [code](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=595607) to the locked [Laundry Room Door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598489).

title: Uninterrupted Service
description: Task: Get through the laundry without harming any of the workers. Solution: Reach the [window exit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598648) of the Laundry Room without attacking, dazing, or otherwise harming the workers. Instead, use environmental distractions to pull away workers' attention and slip past them. Try to pick up the [Laundry Worker](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598581) Disguise to make the second half of the floor easier to bypass. This pairs will with another Laundry challenge, [Squeaky Clean](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598662).

title: Do Not Disturb
description: Task: Enter Room 207. Solution: Room 207's door is locked, and there's no keycard to be found. Instead, climb through the corridor's [open window](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598677) to access Room 207 through its [balcony door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598702). This will cause the guest inside will yell at Bond for the intrusion. Bond can use a Bluff charge to get out of the confrontation.

title: Squeaky Clean
description: Task: Get through the laundry without getting spotted. Solution: The opposite challenge to [Getting Dirty](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598574). Use distractions and stealth to reach the [window exit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598648) of the Laundry Room without alerting any workers that Bond is trespassing. This pairs well with another Laundry challenge, [Uninterrupted Service](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598660).

title: Chimera
description: Task: Solve the puzzle in the dining room on the first try. Solution: There is a [Torn Book Page](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598728) on the nearby trolley that hints at an important trio of animal sigils: Lion, Goat, Snake. Interact with the gold dial above the fireplace mantle to input the correct sequence on the first try.

title: Housekeeping
description: Task: Get a staff member to open Room 205. Solution: 1. In the corridor, distract the [guard outside](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598521) by breaking the [Knight's Armour](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598528) or [Grandfather Clock](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598522) 2. [Eavesdrop](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598666) on maid's phone call to learn the guest Room 205 doesn't want to be disturbed 3. [Distract](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598522) the man in a suit next to Room 205's door to remove the nearby watcher 4. Flip the [Room 205](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598525) sign from red (Do Not Disturb) to green (Housekeeping) 5. When the maid notices the changed sign, she'll knock on the door before entering. Follow her into the room without getting caught.

[Room Service](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598681) 5. [Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598685) 6. [Discarded Suit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598688)

title: Completionist: All the Time in the World
description: Task: Complete all challenges in All the Time in the World to unlock the Chauffeur Uniform in TacSim. Solution: Complete all 26 challenges in the chapter All the Time in the World. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file.

title: Pacifist: All the Time in the World
description: Task: Complete "Uninterrupted Service" and "Peace Studies". Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area without harming guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Uninterrupted Service](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598660) - [Peace Studies](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598449)

title: Ghost: All the Time in the World
description: Task: Complete "Squeaky Clean" and "Silent Study". Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area undetected by guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Squeaky Clean](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598662) - [Silent Study](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598652)

title: Assault: All the Time in the World
description: Task: Complete "Getting Dirty" and "Indiscrete". Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area by defeating guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Getting Dirty](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598574) - [Indiscrete](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/grand-carpathian-hotel?locationIds=598658)

title: Floor It!
description: Task: Reach top speed during the car chase. Solution: During the car chase sequence, hold down gas continuously while avoiding obstacles to reach top speed.

title: Firebrand
description: Task: Destroy 5 explosive barrels. Solution: During the shootout at the air field (17 The Abandoned Air Field), shoot 5 explosive barrels until they explode.

title: No Brakes
description: Task: Dislodge the vehicle locking mechanism in the airplane. Solution: During the shootout on the plane (18 Flying Dark), shoot the explosive barrels next to the vehicle in the cargo bay.

title: Travelling Light
description: Task: Throw three hostiles from the aircraft. Solution: In the second room during the plane shootout (18 Flying Dark), the plane tilting will cause the side doors to fly off the hinges. Grab enemies and direct them towards an opened door. It does NOT count if the enemy falls out as a result of extreme plane tilting.

title: A Beautiful Waste
description: Task: Destroy 5 premium wine bottles during the cellar fight. Solution: In the wine cellar, Bond will engage the Blond Man in a melee fight. Use charging, opponent grabbing, and other techniques to direct combat towards the glass display cases. Once they shatter, throw the Premium Wine Bottle at the Blond Man. Repeat until the challenge is complete.

title: Pacifist: Against the Odds
description: Task: Go through the central camp taking down only two soldiers. Solution: Successfully complete the objective "Save the captives" with the limitation of using takedowns on only two soldiers. 1. Soldier in container G9 holding the [Storage Key](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/iceland?locationIds=598910), which is required to free the MI6 Hostages inside 2. Solider in container B4 interrogating the other MI6 Hostages.

title: Ghost: Against the Odds

title: Assault: Against the Odds
description: Task: Fight 4 soldiers without alerting the camp. Solution: The key to this challenge is finding solitary hostiles, far from everyone else or inside a container. Silent takedowns do NOT count, but they can be useful for getting rid of a hostile's nearby allies before engaging them in melee combat.

title: No Help Needed
description: Task: Go through the central camp without using any distractions. Solution: Avoid any environment or device interactions that create a distraction.

title: Full of Surprises

title: Fall Guy
description: Task: Defeat Omar by throwing him over the railing. Solution: During the [Fight Pit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=731068) Opportunity, Bond will need to defeat Omar to earn a spot in the tournament. Grab Omar and shove him towards any metal railing. There isn't a timer on the practice fight, so just be patient, block Omar's hits, and wait for an opening. _Tip: If you're trying to combine this challenge with [Bottled It!](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=607265), make sure to throw a bottle at Omar before throwing him over the railing._

title: Bottled It!
description: Task: Hit every enemy with a throwable object (Fight Pit). Solution: There are four total rounds that Bond must defeat during the [Fight Pit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=731068) tournament. There's a limited amount of bottles; accuracy is key. Get close to a bottle while keeping the arena challenger in sight; quick throw to stagger the enemy. - Practice: Omar - Round 1: Yahya - Round 2: The Jnoun - Round 3: The Hammer Round 2 poses the most difficulty. The quick throw mechanic is based on automatic targeting, which can accidentally waste multiple bottles on the same fighter. After hitting one fighter, it helps to quickly defeat them to prevent bond from auto-targeting the same fighter multiple times. Use a Q-Watch gadget on the bottle-dazed fighter to setup a quick, one-hit takedown. _Tip: If you want to combine this challenge with [Fall Guy](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=607264), take note that the bottle only dazes Omar; Bond can still throw him over the railing._

title: Hammer Time
description: Task: Defeat 'The Hammer' at the fight pit. Solution: 'The Hammer' is the final challenger during the [Fight Pit](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=731068) Opportunity. Bond can win the ol' fashion way, or use Q-Watch gadgets to daze the hulking competitor for a one-hit victory.

title: Silent Line
description: Task: Get the burner phone in Scorpius' hideout without eliminating or knocking out anyone. Solution: Beyond the hideout's [Security Check](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611000), Bond cannot attack or takedown anyone. This includes triggering with environmental hazards. Instead, rely on staying hidden and using sound distractions. Within the hideout, Bond can find a [disguise](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611002) that greatly reduces the difficulty of this challenge.

title: Soldier Boy
description: Task: Use a disguise inside the Scorpius hideout. Solution: Find the [Scorpius Uniform](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611002) inside the hideout.

title: Art Lover
description: Task: Complete the Scorpius deal. Solution: The Scorpius opportunity begins with an [eavesdropped conversation](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611001) and eventually leads to Container 76. After opening the shipping container, Bond is ambushed by Scorpius mercenaries. Survive to complete the art deal and challenge.

title: Sightseeing
description: Task: Reach the antenna without knocking out or eliminating enemies. Solution: During [The Crypto Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) Opportunity, Bond will be tasked with reaching the [Aleph Cell Tower](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=713315). After entering the chainlink gate behind the laundromat, do not knock out or eliminate any enemies until Bond reaches an unavoidable fistfight after kicking down a plywood wall.

title: Secure Transportation
description: Task: Hack the crypto hardware wallet. Solution: Complete [The Crypto Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) Opportunity, which ends in hacking the [Aleph Cell Tower](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=713315).

title: Shoot 'Em Up
description: Task: Take on the shooting range challenge. Solution: Basim runs a [shooting range](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611020) in the market's weapon district. He's offering $30,000 to anyone who can hit 10 targets before the timer runs out. For this challenge, just attempting the shooting gallery is enough.

title: Gunslinger
description: Task: Hit all targets in the shooting range. Solution: Basim runs a [shooting range](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611020) in the market's weapon district. He's offering $30,000 to anyone who can hit 10 targets before the timer runs out. For this challenge, you must hit all 10 targets and win the game! _Tip: Use Bond's Focus to slow down time._

title: Cupped
description: Task: Play the cup game in the market. Solution: [Aadan](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611022) runs the Cup Game in the markets of Aleph. He's offering the "Jewel of Jahari" to anyone who can correctly find the red jewel inside the shuffled cups. For this challenge, attempting the cup game is enough. _Tip: Use Bond's Q-Lens to clearly see a jewel inside the middle cup._

title: Tech Support
description: Task: Help Rogue Decoder fix his setup. Solution: After [paying the auction fee](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=610995), Greenway and Bond will be led through the auction venue. On the way, a DJ will complain his tech isn't working. 1. Speak to the DJ and offer to repair his equipment 2. Turn on the generator to the right of the DJ booth 3. Pick up a fuse in the open crate by the velvet rope 4. Install new fuse in the large speaker to the right

title: Show Me the Money
description: Task: Collect 140k in the market. Solution: To [enter the auction](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=610995), Bond must search Aleph for $100k. However, there is far more than $100k to be found across opportunities and pickpocketing. Bond will lose hint tracking after reaching $100k. So, the strategy for this challenge is to earn $80-90k from a few small or medium opportunities, then collect a final large reward to reach the $140k threshold. Example Sequence: 1. Fight Club ($60k) 2. Nirmala's Lost Jewel ($33k) 3. The Crypto Wallet ($50k)

title: Easy Does It
description: Task: Reach the crane without knocking out or eliminating enemies. Solution: After the auction, make it to 009's boat without knocking out or eliminating enemies, including environmental hazards! Rely on stealth and gadget distractions to slip by enemies without alerting them. Alternatively, you can make a run for it and hope Bond doesn't die before reaching the boat.

title: No Trouble at All
description: Task: Do not trigger any confrontations in The Past Never Dies. Solution: Do not engage in any confrontations: trespassing alerts, melee fights, and/or shootouts. Follow your preferred stealth route; takedowns are allowed as long as they do not alert guards or trigger reinforcements.

title: Wheels Up
description: Task: Get the Land Rover to lift its wheels off the ground. Solution: After a cutscene with Bawma, Bond and Greenway will be given a car to investigate the Transworld Shipwreck. Leave Aleph and head towards a ramp into a shipwreck. Floor it and get some sick air.

title: Silence is Violence
description: Task: Perform 10 silent takedowns in The Past Never Dies. Solution: During the shipwreck infiltration sections, use stealth takedowns on 10 enemies.

title: The Big Bang
description: Task: Kill 3 enemies with a single explosion. Solution: There are two ideal moments to earn this challenge: traversing the shipwreck towards 009's Boat after the auction, and the shootout in the chapter finale. Both are littered with explosive objects and convenient enemy clusters.

title: Make Them Count
description: Task: Eliminate 6 enemies with one pistol magazine during the last stand. Solution: In the chapter finale, Greenway will give Bond a pistol with a single magazine. Make every shot count. Take it slow, remember to use Focus, and aim for the head.

title: Laser Show
description: Task: Reveal the lasers on 009's boat in every possible way. Solution: Use all three methods to reveal the hidden lasers through the garden tier of 009's boat. The method only counts towards the challenge if it actually reveals/triggers a laser! - Turn on sprinklers - Use Smoke Pod gadget on powder piles - Use Dart or Laser gadgets on hanging planters

title: Scorpius Uniform
description: After bypassing the [guarded entrance](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611000), climb into the left side of the shipwreck-turned-hideout. The disguise is on top of crates in the middle of the room.

title: Poster
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Shooting Range Below where Greenway is hanging out, there a bright poster advertising a [shooting range](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611020) and $30,000 prize. This exact poster is located at several points throughout Aleph. They all give the same hint.

title: Scorpius Hideout & Burner Phone
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Scorpius [START] After descending the stairs from Greenway, immediately turn right and head towards a pickup truck. Stand against the truck and eavesdrop on two Scorpius guards discussing an illegal art deal at the Scorpius Hideout. Details of the deal are on a burner phone.

title: Scorpius Art Deal
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Scorpius Obtain the [Burner Phone](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611003) to learn Scorpius' art deal is happening at [Container 76](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611010), behind the [large anchor](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611005).

title: Shooting Range
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Shooting Range Inspect the display of guns on the car hood. The seller will recommend Bond visit [Basim's shooting range](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611020) in the market's weapon district.

title: Buyer Carrying Cargo
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Crypto Beneath the bow of the shipwreck, Nirmala runs a pawn ship. Ask about opportunities in the market to learn about a [crypto sale](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016).

title: Nirmala's Lost Jewel
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: The Jewel of Jahari [START] Beneath the bow of the shipwreck, Nirmala runs a pawn ship. Ask if Bond can help her with any issues. Nirmala will mention a local swindler is using her jewel as a prize for his [cup game](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611022). If you can retrieve the jewel, she'll pay you a finder's fee.

title: Crypto Wallet Carrier's Phone
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: The Crypto Wallet [START] Lean against a hightop table to eavesdrop on man talking about a crypto wallet on his phone. Moneypenny will flag the info and task Bond with hacking the phone signal. Follow the man until the hack is 100% complete.

title: Crypto Wallet Holder
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: The Crypto Wallet After [eavesdropping](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) on the phone conversation and hacking the phone's signal, Bond will end at a shop across from Nirmala. Complete other auction fee opportunities until Moneypenny contacts Bond with the Crypto Buyer's location.

title: Shooting Range
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Shooting Range Speak to [Basim](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611020) and attempt the shooting range challenge. He's offering $30,000 to anyone who can hit 10 targets before the timer runs out. _Tip: Use Bond's Focus to slow down time._

title: The Red Jewel
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: The Jewel of Jahari Win Aadan's Cup Game to receive a hint there's a pawn shop at the market's entrance that would be interested in Bond's new prize. _Tip: If you have yet to speak with [Nirmala](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611015), this is your hint she's offering a finder's fee for the red jewel._

title: Aleph Cell Tower
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: The Crypto Wallet Moneypenny's signal trace leads to a woman in a white pantsuit browsing the market. Distract her to pickpocket the Crypto Hardware Wallet.

title: The Fight Pit
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Fight Pit Speak to the arena promoter outside to learn about the tournament inside. There's a cash prize for the winner!

title: Yasin, The Trainer
description: Objective: Obtain Auction Fee Opportunity: Fight Pit [START] Enter the Fight Pit and head to the second floor. Eavesdrop on the Ringmaster's conversation to learn Yasin is down a fighter and looking for a replacement. Speak to the ringmaster, and he'll mention Yasin can be found either at the bar or gym. Speak to Yasin and earn your spot in the fight pit.

title: Scorpius Security
description: After descending the stairs from Greenway, immediately turn right and head towards a pickup truck. Standing at the chainlink gate, two guards are watching the entrance to the Scorpius Hideout. After [eavesdropping](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611001) on the guards' conversation, one will enter the hideout and the other will stay behind. Follow some cable to a power generator. Turn it off to lure the other guard away and create an opening for Bond to slip through the entrance.

description: A solitary mercenary is blocking the location of Scorpius' illegal art deal.

title: Bawma
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market In the market's weapon district, there is an antiques seller with a Delivery Box on display. Inspect the object for intel about Bawma.

title: John Greenway
description: The Past Never Dies | 08 Examine the Crime Scene Inside 009's boat, enter the room with the conspiracy yarn board. Immediately turn left. Inspect the Photo of Greenway on a cabinet in the corner next to a bust statue.

title: ATAC Device
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market During the [Crypto Wallet Carrier's Phone](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) Opportunity, Bond will need to climb the [Aleph Cell Tower](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=713315). After smashing through a wall and defeating the Brute behind it, you'll come to a series of gaps to traverse. As you round the corner leading to the signal tower, drop down instead of climbing up to reach a crossing to the opposite side. Behind the wall, the ATAC Device is on a crate. If you use the zipline without first picking up the collectible, you will need to restart the checkpoint and try again.

title: Pirate Grillz
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market With $100k in Bond's pocket, walk back to the [auction security checkpoint](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=610995). Before going up the stairs to pay the fee, turn around and look for a man in a white shirt selling goods across from Nirmala's pawn shop. The memento is on the shop's crate stack.

title: Crocodile Tooth
description: The Past Never Dies | 09 Leaving Aleph After a cutscene with Bawma, Bond and Greenway will be given a car to leave Aleph. Before getting in the car, walk past it towards a table straight ahead.

title: 6 of Bells
description: The Past Never Dies | 02 Arriving at Aleph After exiting the car with Greenway, Bond will enter a shipwreck that's been turned into a marketplace. Take the left path and keep an eye out for a bathroom behind the gun shop stairs. Playing Card is on the ledge of a bathtub.

title: 9 of Acorns
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market Required: Laser Strap (Q-Watch Gear) Next to the [Scorpius Hideout Security Check](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611000) there is a row of aquariums. On the middle aquarium, use the Laser Strap to break the glass and pick up the collectible.

title: Ober of Acorns
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market Required: Laser Strap (Default load out does NOT include this gadget!) From the [Large Anchor](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611005), walk through the yellow shipping containers. To the left of a parked truck is a green utility cabinet. Use the Laser Strap to break the padlock and find the card inside.

title: Ace of Roses
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market Head to the second floor of the Fight Pit. Exit the door by the bar, and make a right-hand U-turn. Next to a weight rack, there's a shaded lounge nook. Playing card is on the table.

title: Banner of Shields
description: The Past Never Dies | 07 Find 009 On the second level of 009's boat, Bond will need to navigate through hidden laser traps. Card is next to a chess set and lounge chair on the rear of the second level.

title: 6 of Shields
description: The Past Never Dies | 10 Find a Way Inside the Shipwreck Inside the Transworld Shipwreck, Bond will follow spycraft clues to parkour through 009's traps. Before lowering the bridge for Greenway, stop at the trio of barrels and pick up the playing card.

title: Mauritania Postcard
description: The Past Never Dies | 03 Black Market Required: Laser Strap (Default load out does NOT include this gadget!) Next to the [Mercenary](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611008) guarding the Scorpius art deal, there is a chainlink cage. Use the Laser Strap to break the cage's padlock. Postcard is next to a laptop.

title: Lighter
description: On a crate near some seafood stalls.

title: Vault
description: Vault over the side of the boat.

title: Vault
description: Vault over the side of the boat.

title: Vault
description: Vault over the side of the boat.

title: Greenway
description: After Bond is unable to enter the [auction](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=610995), Greenway will lean against a blue container at the top of [metal stairs](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=610994).

title: Burner Phone
description: After bypassing the [guarded entrance](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611000), enter the right side of the shipwreck-turned-hideout. Burner phone is on the second floor, on a table behind a white marker board.

title: Large Anchor
description: A key visual landmark while navigating the tangle of shops in Aleph.

title: Money Bundle x 2
description: From the [Large Anchor](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611005), walk through the yellow shipping containers. One guard is static, leaning against the red wall of the shipwrec; another guard is patrolling but often stops to hangout with the static guard. Each guard is carrying $3100, totaling $6200 if you pickpocket both. Use the Q-Lens to spot the yellow-highlighted money bundle in their pocket.

title: Money Bundle
description: Patrolling soldier can be pickpocketed to gain $3100 towards the auction entrance fee. Often stops in front of the laundromat. Use the Q-Lens to spot the yellow-highlighted money bundle in their pocket.

title: Basim's Shooting Range
description: Required: $3,000 per attempt Shoot 10 targets before the timer runs out to win $30,000.

title: Money Bundle
description: Patrolling leader can be pickpocketed to gain $3100 towards the auction entrance fee. Use the Q-Lens to spot the yellow-highlighted money bundle in their pocket.

title: Aadan's Cup Game
description: Required: $3,500 per attempt Correctly guess which shuffled cup contains the red jewel. If Bond wins the game, Aadan will hand over the "Jewel of Jahari."

title: Crypto Hardware Wallet
description: Moneypenny's signal trace during [The Crypto Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) Opportunity leads to a woman in a white pantsuit browsing the market. Distract her to pickpocket the Crypto Hardware Wallet.

title: Aleph Cell Tower
description: After acquiring the [Crypto Hardware Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611050) during [The Crypto Wallet](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/mauritania?locationIds=611016) Opportunity, Bond will be tasked with climbing the Aleph Cell Tower. The chainlink gate behind the market's laundromat will unlock and begin a stealth/parkour sequence.

title: Money Bundle
description: On the second floor of the fight pit, a solider standing by the bar can be pickpocketed to gain $3100 towards the auction entrance fee. Use the Q-Lens to spot the yellow-highlighted money bundle in their pocket.

title: Completionist: Time to Die
description: Task: Complete all challenges in Time to Die to unlock the Resort Casual Outfit in TacSim. Solution: Complete all 23 challenges in the chapter Time to Die. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file.

title: Pacifist: Time to Die
description: Task: Complete "Wraith" and "Unlicensed to Kill." Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area without harming guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Wraith](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927161) - [Unlicensed to Kill](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927159)

title: Ghost: Time to Die
description: Task: Complete "The Quiet Man" and "Panther." Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area undetected or unharmed. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [The Quiet Man](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927155) - [Panther](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927157)

title: Assault: Time to Die
description: Task: Complete "Lights Out" and "Who's Counting?" Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area by defeating guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Lights Out](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927166) - [Who's Counting?](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927163)

title: Pool Inspector
description: Task: Stealth your way into the Serenity Space. Solution: Theresa Lorca can be found within the Serenity Space. However, Bond will be rejected by the security staffed at the entrance. Instead, go back to the entrance to Bond's Lot Villa. There is a [section of rock that can be climbed](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927566). Follow the foliage, then vault over the railing into the Serenity Space.

title: Yogi
description: Task: Enter Hung Villa as "the yoga instructor." Solution: Speak to [Hung Villa Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927203) and learn about Ramon's [yoga session](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927206). Follow the hint trail to find the [Blue Yoga Mat](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927277) and impersonate Ramon's instructor.

title: Zen No More
description: Task: Change the music in Tranquillity Cave. Solution: Interact with the [Laptop](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927276) inside the Yoga Storage Room to switch up the music vibes.

title: Blanc The Brut
description: Task: Get rid of Velvet Lantern bartender through intimidation or persuasion. Solution: Ellis White requires the bar keys from the Velvet Lantern Bar to trust Bond. Interact with the [Wine Menu](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927261) at the bar. Speak to the bartender and attempt to order something off menu. Bond can either be aggressive or friendly—either tactic forces the bartender to abandon his post to fulfill Bond's unreasonable request.

title: Party Crasher
description: Task: Enter Ellis' party by stealing a party flyer. Solution: Ellis White is having an invite-only party at the Ocean View Bar. Speak to the [Ocean View Bar Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927228) to start this hint sequence. The easiest method is to create a distraction by turning on the nearby [hose](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927230). Pickpocket a [Party Flyer](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927233) while the guest is distracted.

title: Key Master
description: Task: Get the Ocean View bar key from the storage room without being detected. Solution: Start by following the guide for [Blanc The Brut](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927151) to get rid of the watchful eyes at the bar. There are two more employees inside the bar's storage room, which can be distracted by sabotaging the vat's [hose](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927264). The challenge is completed upon acquiring the keys; Bond does not need to find a stealthy exit.

title: Bathroom Bomb
description: Task: Knock out Ramon's security detail in the bathroom from the roof window above. Solution: Follow the same cliffside path from [The Quiet Man](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927155) to quietly infiltrate Hung Villa. When you reach the patio kitchen, keep left through the foliage through an opening in the rocks. There will be two additional guards here. Distract or take them out so you can [climb up](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927589) a series of rock ledges to reach the villa rooftop. Walk over to the [Skylight](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927586), hack it open, and complete a takedown of the solitary bathroom guard.

title: The Quiet Man
description: Task: Enter the Hung Villa and confront Ramon without being detected. Solution: Facing the Hung Villa entrance, turn left down the stone path and [drop down](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927581) from the path ledge. Traverse the cliff and pool ledges beneath Hung Villa until you can [climb up](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927584) into the villa's foliage. Hack the [barbeque](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927283) on the villa's poolside patio to distract the guards and pass through undetected. Challenge completes after Bond enters the second floor and approaches Ramon.

title: Give Me A Minute
description: Task: Let Lorca stabilize before investigating the Emperor Villa. Solution: After placing Q-Traks on all three targets, Bond relax on a lounge chair by the pool. Moneypenny will interrupt to alert Bond that Lorca's heart rate is spiking. Ignore Moneypenny's urgency and instead walk calmly, linger to enjoy the view, and take your time. Eventually, Moneypenny will announce that Lorca's condition stabilized.

title: Panther
description: Task: Reach the Emperor Villa's roof without being detected. Solution: During the Emperor Villa infiltration, keep to the grass coverage and be patient with guard movement. Keep left and head towards the back of the villa to reach the rooftop staircase.

title: Phantom
description: Task: Reach Ellis in the wine cellar without being detected. Solution: Remain crouched or behind cover, knocking out enemies as needed to clear Bond'd path forward.

title: Unlicensed to Kill
description: Task: Rescue Ellis without killing any Webb mercenaries. Solution: Ellis is in the wine cellar guarded by two unavoidable hostiles. Shoot out their legs to knock them out without voiding the challenge.

title: Silent Night
description: Task: Resort night: Take out 5 enemies with a silenced gun without being detected. Solution: During the Emperor Villa infiltration, Bond will get to try out the new silenced pistol. Aim for the head to kill enemies in one shot. For enemies with helmets, use the Laser Strap first to get rid of their armor to get a clean headshot.

title: Wraith
description: Task: Reach Lorca without being detected. Solution: Choose your favorite stealth strategies to reach Lorca. It's HIGHLY recommended to bring Smoke Pods to get through several Tanks staring directly where Bond needs to move. _Tip: If you're struggling with this challenge, there is a glitch to auto-complete it. Abandon all stealth and run towards the waypoint, killing hostiles as needed. As soon as the cutscene begins with Bond running after Lorca, pause and select Restart Checkpoint. This will loop and restart the cutscene instead of the checkpoint. Skip the cutscene and exit to the menu; you can check the Challenges and see Wraith is complete._

title: Thief
description: Task: Steal 3 of Greenway's kills during the shootout in the quarry. Solution: During the Quarry shootout, Greenway will shoot hostiles from a sniper perch. Patiently wait behind cover. When Greenway aims at an enemy, pop up and take the shot instead.

title: Who's Counting?
description: Task: Get more kills than Greenway in the quarry blitz shootout. Solution: During the Quarry shootout, shoot everything and everyone. Greenway moves slowly between sniper positions, so all Bond has to do is stay ahead. Environmental hazards like [Marble Madness](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927164) are great for killing multiple enemies in one shot.

title: Marble Madness
description: Task: Kill 5 Webb mercs with marble slabs in the quarry. Solution: During the Quarry shootout, use the Q-Lens to reveal weak points on large marble slabs. Shoot the weak point for the marble slab to crush enemies below.

title: You Talk Too Much
description: Task: Throw the Webb merc over the railing of the mining truck. Solution: During the Quarry shootout, Bond will commandeer a large construction truck. Climb aboard, grab the guard at the top, and run towards the railing.

title: Lights Out
description: Task: Knock out the power and kill all the lights. Solution: During the Quarry's final area, aim at the red barrels or yellow fuse boxes at the base of the light towers.

title: Two Birds, One Stone
description: Task: Kill one or more enemies with a single shot using Greenway. Solution: During the Quarry shootout, use the Q-Lens on the yellow-highlighted construction crane. Greenway will shoot it and kill four enemies in one fell swoop.

title: Party Flyer
description: After learning about Ellis White's invite-only party at the Ocean View Bar, Bond will be able to see several guests nearby are holding. Distract any of them to pickpocket the invitation to impersonate a legitimate party guest.

title: Yoga Instructor
description: Inside the Yoga Storage Room, inspect the note taped on the wall to learn Mr. Hernandez has a very special blue yoga mat he requires for his lessons. Pick up the yoga mat to impersonate Ramon's yoga instructor.

title: Ramon Hernandez's Location
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Locate Ramon Hernandez Eavesdrop on two gardeners to learn Ramon is located in the Hung Villa.

title: Hint
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Hidden Access Lean against the bar to eavesdrop on security guards on break discussing the unguarded entrance to Ramon's villa.

title: The Yoga Session
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: The Yoga Session Speak to [Hung Villa Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927203) and ask about Ramon Hernandez. Bond will learn Hernandez is waiting on a yoga teacher for his daily appointment.

title: Ellis White's Party
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Locate Ellis White Lean against the bar to eavesdrop on two guests gossiping about Ellis White's party at the Ocean View Bar.

title: Ellis White's Party
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Locate Ellis White Sit on a poolside lounge chair to eavesdrop on guests complaining about Ellis White's party at the Ocean View Bar.

title: Party Flyer
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Party Flyer Speak to [Ocean View Bar Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927228) to learn Ellis White's party is invite-only. Find a [Party Flyer](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927233) to gain legitimate access to the party.

title: Bar Keys
description: Objective: Plant Q-Tracks Opportunity: Party Time After gaining access to Ellis White's party, Bond will be immediately confronted by White's crew. To gain their trust, Bond must find the keys to the [locked minibar](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927256) so the party can keep going.

title: Wine Menu
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Party Time Interact with the Wine Menu to learn the selection of drinks available at the Velvet Lantern Bar. Speak to a bartender and order something off the menu to force the bartender away from his post.

title: Hint
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Theresa Lorca Eavesdrop on guests gossiping on the Tranquility Platform to learn Theresa Lorca is relaxing at the Serenity Space.

title: Blue Yoga Mat
description: Objective: Plant Q-Traks Opportunity: Ramon Hernandez Lean against the railing to eavesdrop on the resort staff trying to find Ramon's blue yoga mat inside the Tranquility Cave.

title: Ocean View Bar Minibar Key
description: Opens the [Locked Minibar](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/the-pearl?locationIds=927256) that Ellis White is demanding Bond open. Taped to a cabinet in the back of the bar's employee area.

title: Yoga Storage Key
description: Carried by a yoga instructor trying to find Ramon's blue yoga mat.

title: Q
description: Going Old School | 04 In The Zone Inside the Q-Lab, head to the back to collect your field equipment for the next chapter, Time to Die. Before speaking with Q, head towards the computers to the right. Inspect the "Driving Gloves" on the desk.

title: Theresa Lorca
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets After successfully entering the Serenity Space, a cutscene will automatically trigger with Theresa Lorca. At the edge of the pool, she'll leave behind some "Keynote Presentation" documents.

title: Caliban
description: Time to Die | 07 Suit Up After returning to Loi Villa to grab Bond's tuxedo, there will be new intel waiting on a living room console table. Inspect the "Caliban Profile" document.

title: Riptide
description: Time to Die | 15 Tracking Damien During the Quarry chase, Greenway will free Bond and begin working together. Head down the marble tunnel and turn to your right. Inspect the "Gun Case" on the giant construction spool.

title: Tarot Deck
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets Inside the Hung Villa, on the bedside end table on the second floor.

title: Diving Watch
description: Time to Die | 07 Suit Up After returning to Loi Villa to grab Bond's tuxedo, there will be a new memento waiting on the bedroom nightstand.

title: Banner of Acorns
description: Time to Die | 03 A Package From Q Inside Bond's room (Lot Villa 2F), on the bathroom sink counter.

title: 8 of Shields
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets On a small table at the right-side corner of the Tranquility Platform.

title: 9 of Roses
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets Inside the Tranquility Cave's Yoga Storage, found on the yoga mat storage shelves.

title: Under of Bells
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets Inside the Hung Villa, on the bathroom counter on the second floor.

title: King of Roses
description: King of Roses | 05 The Three Targets On the counter at the Lotus Bar.

title: Vietnam Postcard
description: Time to Die | 05 The Three Targets Within the Ocean View Bar, on a lounge side table.

title: Vault
description: Vault over the railing to walk south through foliage into the Ocean View Bar.

title: The View
description: Interact with the balcony for a quiet moment to enjoy the spectacular view.

title: Completionist: Knightfall
description: Task: Complete all challenges in Knightfall to unlock the White Tux in TacSim. Solution: Complete all 23 challenges in the chapter Knightfall. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file.

title: Pacifist: Knightfall
description: Task: Complete "Discretion Advised" and "IT Specialist." Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area without harming guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Discretion Advised](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607232) - [IT Specialist](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607241)

title: Ghost: Knightfall
description: Task: Complete "Hand of God" and "Underdressed." Solution: Complete two challenges that require passing through an area undetected or unharmed. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Hand of God](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607233) - [Underdressed](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607239)

title: Assault: Knightfall
description: Task: Complete "Server Crash," "All the Time in the World," and "Makeover." Solution: Complete three challenges that require passing through an area by defeating guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Server Crash](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607243) - [All the Time in the World](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607238) - [Makeover](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607234)

title: Excusive Access
description: Task: Obtain Roger Finch's keycard. Solution: After receiving a Dart from Greenway, Roger Finch is now "occupied" in the Diamond Lounge restroom. It seems his [office keycard](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607410) has fallen on the floor, and Bond can grab it from the neighboring "Out of Order" stall. To reach the Diamond Lounge restroom, use the [control panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607350) in the B. Webb Lounge. This will call the Cleaning Robot currently in the Faraday Room, which causes the [locked door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607356) to open briefly as the robot exits. Inside, use the [vent](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607405) access and crawl through to the restroom.

title: Tactical Pause
description: Task: Complete all personal conversations with Greenway. Solution: While wandering the hallways of 35F, Greenway will lean against a railing overlooking a decorative pond. Interact with the railing to join Greenway. Exhaust all dialogue options before leaving the conversation.

title: High Ground (Knightfall)
description: Task: Take the vent to open the door for Greenway on the executive 2nd floor. Solution: Greenway will stand at the [East Wing Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607525) and warn Bond about the sleeping guard on the other side. Enter the Maintenance Room and climb through the [Ceiling Vent](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607544). Hack the [Door Controller](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607556) on the other side for Greenway.

title: Discretion Advised
description: Task: Get through the executive 2nd floor meeting room area without alerting or taking out anyone. Solution: After bypassing the guard sleeping near [East Wing Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607525) on 35F, get through the remainder of the floor without alerting or taking down anyone. The easiest method is to Bluff past the duo standing in the middle after the Watcher retreats to the side office, then walk directly through the exit. No distractions, no stealth.

title: Hand of God
description: Task: Take down everyone in the executive 2nd floor meeting room area without getting spotted. Solution: After bypassing the guard sleeping near [East Wing Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607525) on 35F, get through the remainder of the floor while taking down every guard.

title: Makeover
description: Task: Smash four security guards into meeting room windows. Solution: There is a cluster of guards lounging around meeting rooms in the East Wing. Melee grab a guard and direct them towards any of the large meeting room windows.

title: Blackball
description: Task: Challenge Greenway to a game of pool. Solution: In the S. Webb Lounge on the Executive 2nd Floor, interact with the pool game rack on the wall to challenge Greenway to a game.

title: Crackerjack
description: Task: Open the safe on the first try. Solution: Inside the Penthouse, Bond will investigate several hints to learn the code to [Webb's Safe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608021). The correct answer is 1493.

title: Epic Fail
description: Task: Fail the safe code seven times in a row. Solution: When Bond reveals [Webb's Safe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608021), intentionally mess up the code seven times in a row. (Note: the correct code is 1493. So, don't input that.)

title: All the Time in the World
description: Task: Take out all the guards during the run to the Perch. Solution: After recording Webb and Damien's conversation, a 4-minute escape timer will start to reach the [Perch Access Elevator](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608006). Inspect the [Bastet Sculpture](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608022) on Webb's desk to open a secret passage. [Vault](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608028) down to the lower executive floor, and start heading to the [Perch Access Elevator](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608006). Despite the ticking clock, take the time to defeat every single guard. Reserve gadget charges for more difficult enemies to set Bond up for an instant knockout. For all the other enemy fodder, keep it simple: guard, parry, counterattack.

title: Underdressed
description: Task: Get up to the data center without getting spotted. Solution: Either follow the [Safety First](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608067) Hint or use a Dart on the Safety Inspector to lure him away from the corner. Use the new Pass Through spot to bypass the Check-In desk without a lab coat disguise or getting spotted. Linger within the crowd of scientists to avoid detection from security. Use a Dart on the left-side guard to lure him away from a crouching passage beneath the stairs.

title: After Hours
description: Task: Enter the data centre wearing a disguise. Solution: Follow the [Get a Lab Coat](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608069) Hint that leads Bond to a [Locker Key](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608071) and spare [Lab Coat](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608077). Go back to the Check-In desk, and now Bond can pass the checkpoint with security's blessing. Linger within the crowd of scientists to avoid detection from security. Use a Dart on the left-side guard to lure him away from a crouching passage beneath the stairs.

title: IT Specialist
description: Task: Activate all the servers for Greenway without alerting anyone. Solution: Environmental distractions are Bond's best friend in this challenge. Sabotage tech, create disorienting gas clouds, move server racks, etc. Keep an out for guards with noise-protection headphones! They're immune to sound-based distractions, but they won't be alerted when Bond causes chaos outside their immediate line of sight.

title: Service Update
description: Task: Take down eight guards in the data centre, hack the three servers, and return to Greenway without alerting anyone. Solution: Focus Bond's efforts on the outer perimeter of the server room; there are fewer vantage points for enemies to the unconscious bodies Bond leaves behind. Keep an out for guards with noise-protection headphones! They're immune to sound-based distractions, but they won't be alerted when Bond causes chaos outside their immediate line of sight. Completing Service Update also fulfills the challenge requirements for [IT Specialist](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607241).

title: Server Crash
description: Task: Fight ten security guards in the data centre. Solution: Abandon all stealth and start punching! Lure guards away from their clusters to take on smaller fistfights, or use Gadgets to daze guards and setup a one-hit knockout.

title: Closing Time
description: Task: Close four metallic window shutters. Solution: While escaping the Perch, Bond will pass through several windowed rooms overlooking the Cargo Floor and Flight Deck. Use Hack on any four Window Shutters to close them. Note: If you find closed shutters, hack them twice to open and close again for it to count.

title: Blast of Air
description: Task: Overcharge the vents to push four guards over the railings. Solution: Wait for guards to pass in front of Industrial fans to Hack or Laser them into knocking guards over nearby railings. Be patient! If you trigger the Industrials Fans too early, the guards will shoot and break the fan.

title: Gun Nut
description: Task: Use four different firearms during the escape from the Perch. Solution: After escaping the server room through an Escape Vent, Bond will exit onto the Cargo Floor. From here until the end of the level, pickup and use four different firearms to defeat hostiles. Firearms within a similar category but alternate names (e.g. SB-10 SMG vs. Osato-8 SMG) DO count as two different firearms for this challenge. Hostiles will carry the following options: - PDR-9 Pistol - SB-10 SMG - Osato-8 SMG - T&M Compact Shotgun - Storm 12 Gauge Shotgun - DRX 12 Gauge Shotgun - Osato-9 AR

title: Mightier Than the Sword
description: Task: Destroy three structural elements with the missile pen. Solution: Throughout the Cargo Maintenance area, Bond can eliminate enemies by sabotaging structural weak points—ledge supports, walkway bridges, etc. Remember to specifically use the Missile Pen! Most structures can be destroyed through multiple gadgets and won't count towards the challenge.

title: Moving Target
description: Task: Take out every guard in the cargo check room without taking damage. Solution: At the start of Checkpoint 09 Cargo Floor, Bond will drop into Cargo Check and face two soon-to-be-eliminated guards. You can use whatever method you prefer! Melee, Q-Watch gadgets, sabotaging the environment—doesn't matter, just don't take damage.

title: Lab Coat
description: Follow the [Get a Lab Coat](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608069) Hint that leads Bond to a [Locker Key](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608071) stuck inside a Cleaning Robot. Retrieve the key and open Locker 6. Allows Bond to bypass the [Check-In Desk](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608065) guards.

title: Door Sensors
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Door Sensors While exploring the area, Greenway will speculate that the Q-Watch could hack the interior motion sensors. But, you need direct line-of-sight for the gadget to work.

title: Cleaning Robot Info
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: All Access Inspect the flyer on the orange information board to learn the Cleaning Robots can be re-directed with control panels.

title: Isola's Note
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Upon entering the Penthouse, Bond will automatically receive the code hint: Diploma, Painting, Game, Model.

title: Video Game
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Inspect the video game, Hyperion 9, on the bookshelf display. Make a note of the number 9.

title: Android
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Inspect the model of Webb's latest technology, the Tabula Rasa androids.

title: Scale Model
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Inspect the scale model of Webb Industries' Hong Kong offices entitled "Site III". Make a note of the number 3.

title: Diploma
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Inspect the frame diploma for Nicholas Webb's Mathematics degree from King's College. He was first in his class Make a note of the number 1.

title: Painting
description: Objective: Reach the Perch Opportunity: Locate and open the safe Inspect the large painting of a brain, generated by Webb Industries' AI and titled "Basilisk, rendition #4". Make a note of the number 4.

title: Safety First
description: Objective: Catch Up to Greenway Opportunity: Get a Lab Coat Speak to the Safety Inspector in the corner and ask "Who are you?" to learn the inspector is vigilant about any type of accident. (Translation: the Safety Inspector will run away if the [Rubbish Bin](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608066) is lit on fire.)

title: Lost Locker Key
description: Objective: Catch Up to Greenway Opportunity: Get a Lab Coat After getting rejected at the [Check-In Desk](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608065), reenter the hallway outside and eavesdrop on staff talking about a [Lost Locker Key](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608071) that the Cleaning Robot swept up. Use the [Cleaning Robot Control Panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608047) to recall the robot and empty its contents into the [Vacuum Waste Disposal](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608054) within Maintenance.

title: Get a Lab Coat
description: Objective: Catch Up to Greenway Opportunity: Get a Lab Coat After approaching the [Check-In Desk](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608065), Greenway will get a free pass through but Bond will be rejected. Greenway suggests follow his lead and find a lab coat to impersonate a scientist.

title: Office Key
description: Roger Finch's personal keycard. Kick down the "Out of Order" stall door. The keycard has been discarded on the floor and slid under the stall partition. Unlocks [Roger Finch's Office](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607442) and all Clearance Level 1 doors.

title: Security Access Key
description: On the ground next to the knocked-out guard. Opens all Clearance Level 3 doors.

title: Locker Key
description: Inside the Cleaning Robot. Related to [Lost Locker Key](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608068) Hint. Use the [Cleaning Robot Control Panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608047) to recall the robot and empty its contents into the [Vacuum Waste Disposal](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608054) within Maintenance.

title: Clearance Level 1
description: Unlocked By: Use the nearby [Control Panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607350) for Cleaning Robot to open the door, then hack [Door Controller](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607402) so it remains unlocked

title: Maintenance Door
description: Unlocked By: Laser Strap (Destroy Lock) or Kick Down

title: Locked Door
description: Unlocked By: Hack [Door Controller](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607570) on the opposite side of the room. Greenway will enter the room and unlock this door for Bond.

title: Clearance Level 2
description: Greenway and Bond will approach and passing Cleaning Robot will open the door, allowing them temporary access.

title: Clearance Level 2
description: Use a nearby [Control Panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607951) to lure a Cleaning Robot to open the door for Bond.

title: Locked Door
description: Crouch through the [Broken Window](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607984) nearby and open locked door from the other side.

title: Webb's Safe
description: Unlocked By: Numpad Code (1493) According to Isola's hint, the numeric order is: Diploma, Painting, Game, Model. Each one relates to a displayed item in the Penthouse with a number in the description. - [Diploma](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608018) = 1 - [Painting](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608019) = 4 - [Video Game](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608014) = 9 - [Scale Model](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608017) = 3

title: Secret Passage
description: Opens after interacting with the [Bastet Sculpture](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608022) during the Penthouse escape sequence.

title: Server Escape Vent
description: When escaping the server, follow the lit path until you reach a dead-end. Turn right and use the Missile Pen on the wall here to reveal an escape vent. [Vent exits](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=609299) into a maintenance room behind the servers.

title: Stairs to Penthouse
description: Leads To: [Penthouse](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608011) Requires restoring power to [Staircase Controls](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608009).

description: Greenway and Bond will lean against the railing, assessing the hallway and their options to bypass the [locked door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=607986). After spotting the [open window](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608005), Greenway will offer Bond a boost to start climbing.

title: Vault
description: Vault over the glass railing to descend onto the executive floor below (36F).

title: Perch Exit Elevator
description: One-way elevator. Cannot be taken back to [Perch Access Elevator](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608006) on 36F of the Executive Floors.

title: Security Sensor
description: Interact with the panel to disable the motion sensors barring Greenway from crossing the hallway.

title: Power Controls
description: Flip the switch with a red button so the entire row is green to power on the [Staircase Controls](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608009).

title: Staircase Controls
description: Restore power in with the [Power Controls](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608008) in the maintenance rooms nearby. Interact with the controls to activate the stairs.

title: Secret Button
description: Inside the right desk drawer. Reveals [Webb's Safe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608021).

title: Bastet Sculpture
description: When the escape timer starts, interact with the cat sculpture on Webb's desk to reveal a [Secret Passage](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/webb-industries?locationIds=608024).

title: Platform Controls
description: Use the control panel to call the platform.

title: Completionist: Uninvited
description: Task: Complete all challenges in Uninvited to unlock the Funeral Outfit in TacSim. Solution: Complete all 29 challenges in the chapter Uninvited. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file.

title: Pacifist: Uninvited
description: Task: Complete "A Quiet Night," "Just Passing Through," and "Workplace Agreement." Solution: Complete three challenges that require passing through an area without harming guards. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [A Quiet Night](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604566) - [Just Passing Through](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604575) - [Workplace Agreement](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604569)

title: Ghost: Uninvited
description: Task: Complete "Missed Me!", "Top Notch Security," and "Fast Track." Solution: Complete three challenges that require passing through an area undetected or unharmed. This is a cumulative challenge. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Missed Me!](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604558) - [Top Notch Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604567) - [Fast Track](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604576)

title: Assault: Uninvited
description: Task: Complete "Green Fingers," "All Clear," "Health & Safety," and "Art Attack." Solution: Complete four challenges that require passing through an area by defeating guards. It does NOT need to be completed in the same playthrough/save file. - [Green Fingers](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604579) - [All Clear](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604564) - [Health & Safety](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604578) - [Art Attack](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604572)
