description: Task: Eliminate the assassin without taking damage. Solution: During the assassin ambush, use dodge and parry attacks to remain unscathed.

title: Missed Me!
description: Task: Take no shots from the sniper. Solution: After escaping the assassin ambush, a sniper will hone in on Bond's location. Move from cover to cover between sniper shots. Be cautious—some cover objects will be destroyed after a single sniper shot!

title: Gate Crasher
description: Task: Enter the Webb Industries gala without an invitation. Solution: As the chapter title suggests, Bond was not invited to the gala and [Gala Security](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604606) won't let him through. Pickpocket [someone else's invitation](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604608) or pass through the Cloakroom.

title: Say 'Cheese'!
description: Task: Find a way upstairs posing as a photographer. Solution: Gain access to the museum's 2nd floor by completing the "Scooped" Opportunity.

title: Always On Duty
description: Task: Find a way upstairs posing as a security guard. Solution: Follow "The Tardy Guard" Opportunity, or sneak into the Cloakroom through other means.

title: Behind the Scenes
description: Task: Find a way upstairs using the press room backstage door. Solution: There is a hallway that runs behind the Press Room. It is accessible via a keycard-locked [Staff Door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604682), or backstage door beyond the roped-off area in the Press Room. For this challenge, use the backstage door.

title: VIP Entrance
description: Task: Find a way upstairs using a keycard. Solution: There are two [keycard](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604634)-locked doors that lead to upstairs, in the [Press Room](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604682) and [Cafe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604647).

title: All Clear
description: Task: Eliminate 10 guards in the security room. Solution: Anywhere in the security area, eliminate 10 guards.

title: Dropping In
description: Task: Enter the CCTV room through the skylight. Solution: After reading the [Staff Warning](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604747) in the Cantina, Bond can learn about a [climbable pipe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604776) leading to the [skylight window](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604788) above the CCTV room.

title: A Quiet Night
description: Task: Get through the CCTV room without taking out any guards. Solution: The [CCTV Door](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604973) requires a keycard to open. Two keycards are held by guards, but there's a [spare keycard](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604942) in the Security Office.

title: Top Notch Security
description: Task: Get to the CCTV room without getting spotted. Solution: Watch out for guards and security cameras! It's recommended to follow the path for [Dropping In](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604565), which bypasses the security offices via a rooftop skylight.

title: Simon Says
description: Task: Access the CCTV room by only taking down Simon and his friend. Solution: Choose your favorite stealth route to reach the CCTV door. By the pool table outside CCTV, Simon and his friend (the two trench coat guards) are lounging around. All other hostiles in the Security Area are off limits and will void the challenge.

title: Workplace Agreement
description: Task: Get through the workshop without taking down the guards. Solution: The Workshop is a museum employee area accessible after being interrogated (Checkpoint 09 Storage Room). Do not use any takedowns on guards. There are several vent access points to navigate above the Workshop without engaging any guards.

title: Rack N' Roll
description: Task: Exit the workshop through the server room undetected. Solution: At the beginning of the Workshop, use the vent access to walk across the utility racks above the room. In the back-right of the Workshop, there's a small server room. Pick up the keycard inside, then carefully navigate to the Workshop exit.

title: Nothing to Report
description: Task: Take down every guard in the workshop without being spotted. Solution: After entering the Workshop, the guards will initially be grouped together. They will disperse on their patrols, where they can be picked off one by one. Use the Q-Watch to sabotage items around the room to lure guards into better takedown spots.

title: Art Attack
description: Task: Eliminate 3 guards with explosives in the workshop. Solution: The fastest technique is to intentionally alert the guards to Bond's presence and draw them into the central Workshop room. On the tables, there are red explosive canisters you can shoot when guards are nearby.

title: Closed For Maintenance
description: Task: Unlock the maintenance room in the courtyard. Solution: Access the maintenance room with the stairwell vent or by unlocking the door with its required passcode (3256).

title: The Big Bluff
description: Task: Bluff 3 guards at a time in the courtyard. Solution: There are several grouped guards near the Lobby and Dining Room. Walk up directly up to a guard trio and use the Bluff interaction. Make sure you have enough energy charges beforehand to attempt the Bluff!

title: Just Passing Through
description: Task: Get through the courtyard without killing any of the guards. Solution: Use stealth or takedowns to get through the Courtyard. No guns or explosions!

title: Fast Track
description: Task: Get through the courtyard without being compromised. Solution: Use stealth to navigate through the courtyard section without alerting any guards to Bond's presence.

title: 8 For 8
description: Task: Take down 8 guards in the courtyard without being spotted. Solution: Focus on guards standing alone, or use Lure to isolate a single guard from a group.

title: Health & Safety
description: Task: Eliminate 3 guards with scaffolding in the courtyard. Solution: The Courtyard is still under construction and has plenty of perilous scaffolding Bond can sabotage. Use any distraction to lure a guard, then topple the scaffolding by manually pushing or using a Q-Watch gadget.

title: Green Fingers
description: Task: Eliminate 15 guards in the courtyard. Solution: Keep to courtyard's side rooms where guards are gathered in small pockets. Attacking guards in these rooms will prevent every guard in earshot from running at Bond, at the same time.

title: IT Specialists
description: Task: Break 15 screens in the Webb exhibition. Solution: Almost every wall in the Webb Exhibition is comprised of screen panels that can be broken. Grab any gun and go on a screen-shooting spree.

title: Bin Collection
description: Task: Take the 'alternate route' when escaping. Solution: When escaping the Gala with Greenway, keep right while driving the Garbage Truck. Plow through anything in the way and take the ramp exit.

title: Gala Guest
description: Almost every guest in the Reception area is carrying a Webb Gala invitation. Use the Q-Lens to look for the giant golden rectangle in everyone's pockets. Distract any of them to pickpocket the invitation.

title: Camera
description: One half of the Press disguise to bypass the stairwell [Gala security checkpoint](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604643). To complete the disguise, Bond will need a [Press Pass](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604683).

title: Eavesdrop

title: Eavesdrop

Follow-up by speaking to the woman and pretend to be Mike Chauksfield; she'll direct Bond to the Press Room.

title: Rotation Schedule
description: Objective: Get to the Security Room Opportunity: The Tardy Guard After [learning the password](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604653), interact with the tablet to see Harry Sykes is late for work.

title: Tablet Credentials
description: Objective: Get to the Security Room Opportunity: The Tardy Guard Lean against the cafe bar to eavesdrop on staff trying to remember the tablet's login details; they're written on a piece of paper in the drawer next to the refrigerated pastry display.

title: Eavesdrop
description: Objective: Get into the CCTV Room Opportunity: Keycard Duck behind some tables and eavesdrop on a group of security guards in the center of the room. One of them is carrying a [CCTV Keycard](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604752).

title: Staff Warning
description: Objective: Get into the CCTV Room Opportunity: [Dropping In](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604565) Read the note on the break table to learn about a balcony [pipe](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604776) that can be climbed to reach the roof.

title: Skylight Controls
description: Objective: Get into the CCTV Room Opportunity: [Dropping In](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604565) Inspect the note hanging from the chainlink fence to learn the CCTV's skylight can be opened with remote controls.

title: Staff Note
description: Objective: Find Murto Opportunity: Broken Door Locks Inspect the note taped to the wall to learn the Restoration Room's door locks are broken. Bond will need to find a different route to the [Control Panel](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604801). Pickup some battery packs to power Bond's Laser Strap and destroy the padlock on a nearby [chained path](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604793).

title: Eavesdrop

title: CCTV Note
description: Objective: Get into the CCTV Room Opportunity: CCTV Keycards Inspect the note to learn two guards have keycards to the CCTV Room: one in the [office space](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604942), the other in the [cantina](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604752).

title: Museum Keycard
description: Carried by the Gala staff member at the exhibit information desk. [Eavesdrop](https://mapgenie.io/007-first-light/maps/works-and-arts-museum?locationIds=604633) on their conversation to learn about the keycard; it won't show up on the Q-Lens until Bond has learned this info.
